classification: Methodology amendment: specialist qualification before role refinement, one rule for every team size. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL.
decided_by: user 2026-10-04: certify the specialists before applying roles; freeze before the fresh 4v4 k=0 confirmation is read
MOTIVATION_disclosed: Proposed after the sealed 4v4 V1 and R1 results, the stopped defender-only run, and the strategy-conditioned-k development data (k=0 dev: A@B 0.734 > B@B 0.578), which indicated a specialist-stage Pole-B problem. Frozen BEFORE the fresh 4v4 confirmation (SCK_4V4_CONFIRM, 28800001..128) produced any episode: the selection had not sealed and the confirmation had not started.
PIPELINE: PPO specialists -> specialist qualification -> unchanged symmetric role machinery -> crossover -> distillation

RULE_every_team_size.1_existing_pair_qualification: the existing sealed specialist pair (plain, k=0, no roles) is evaluated on a fresh block, four cells; it QUALIFIES iff mean Delta_A^base = V(A,A)-V(B,A) > 0 AND mean Delta_B^base = V(B,B)-V(A,B) > 0 (mean-level development gate; no intervals required)
RULE_every_team_size.2_if_it_qualifies: no new specialists; proceed to the unchanged role stage
RULE_every_team_size.3_if_it_does_not: trigger the fixed candidate procedure (below) exactly once
RULE_every_team_size.applies_to: 2v2, 4v4, 6v6 and any later size; no size-specific rule; only 4v4 is authorized now

EXISTING_PAIR_TEST_4V4.condition: serves as the existing-pair qualification test iff the shared-k selection (SCK amendment 1) seals k_A = k_B = 0, so the four cells are the plain specialists; if it seals k = 1, the existing pair is instead tested on SQ_4V4_GATE before any candidate step

CANDIDATE_PROCEDURE.candidates: exactly 3 per strategy, all NEW (the existing pair is not a candidate); no 4th, no replacement seeds

recipe_locked.note: identical to the stage that produced the current 4v4 specialists; only the seed differs

selection_on_D_select.cells: every candidate on BOTH poles (6 policies x 2 poles x 64 = 768 episodes)
selection_on_D_select.score: Q_A(i) = V(A_i,A) - V(A_i,B);  Q_B(j) = V(B_j,B) - V(B_j,A)
selection_on_D_select.pick: A* = argmax_i Q_A, B* = argmax_j Q_B, independently; tie-break: (1) higher Q, (2) higher intended-pole win rate, (3) lowest preassigned training seed
selection_on_D_select.disclosure: Q rewards being weaker off-pole: by design (a specialist performs strongly in its regime and loses capability when transferred)
selection_on_D_select.lock: A* and B* are locked; no reselection

gate_on_D_gate.cells: the selected pair only, four cells (256 episodes)
gate_on_D_gate.pass: mean Delta_A^base > 0 AND mean Delta_B^base > 0 (development gate)
gate_on_D_gate.fail: STOP the 4v4 line: no further batch, no second-best candidate, no new k. Report: under the frozen PPO specialist recipe, reliable Pole-B specialization does not emerge at 4v4 within the pre-specified candidate budget.

defenders.recipe: the frozen defender-only recipe (k = k_role(4) = 1, frozen specialist ATTACK, N' teacher 0.1 -> 0 over 50k-150k, cadence 4, 200k)

ROLE_STAGE_unchanged.selection: strategy-conditioned-k amendment 1 (strict symmetry): shared k* = argmax_k [V(A,k,A)+V(B,k,B)]/2 over K(4) = {0,1}, tie -> smaller k

final_confirmation.cells: four cells with k_A = k_B = k*
final_confirmation.report: four win rates, margins, Delta_A, Delta_B, paired bootstrap 95% and the multiplicity-aware level; no PASS/FAIL wording

COST_estimate: training 6 x ~5 h (serial) + evaluation ~18-21 h (768 + 256 + role dev + 512 episodes) + defenders ~2 h: roughly 50+ h serial
